rule: Families are not pooled because they all concern combustion in microgravity: fuel phase, apparatus, scale, boundary conditions and observables differ. A finding crosses families only through the transfer engine.

families.name: BASS-II
families.phenomenon: Ignition, flame growth, opposed-flow spread and extinction of solid fuels in low-speed forced flow
families.treatment: First family: PMMA-100 case, B6 measured, family of 8 runs assessed
depth: 129 tests in the NASA experimental table, 6 principal investigators
695 files, 255.77 GiB, every file hashed in the manifest
100 µm PMMA family: 8 runs assessed, 6 rejected by quality gates (kept), 2 measured with the earlier window method and being redone under the window rule (DEC-041)
B6: 77 raw stills sealed; rate 1.99 mm/s at air setting 3 (AR-001)

families.name: BASS
families.phenomenon: Earlier burning and suppression of solids campaign
families.treatment: Related to BASS-II but kept as a separate family

families.name: SoFIE
families.phenomenon: Ignition and extinction of solids: fuel temperature, geometry, flow, oxygen, pressure
families.treatment: Next solid-fuel family; data custody to be established (SDSU)

families.name: SAFFIRE
families.phenomenon: Spacecraft-scale fire spread and smoke in uncrewed Cygnus vehicles
families.treatment: Scale contrast; never mixed directly with duct-scale BASS-II
families.collection: SAFFIRE-I: PSI-98, DOI 10.60555/0t15-1z43 (from the research record; not inspected)

families.name: SAME / SAME-R
families.phenomenon: Smoke and aerosol produced by combustion
families.treatment: Evidence for detection and combustion products, not for flame spread; SAME and SAME-R kept separate

families.name: FLEX / FLEX-2
families.treatment: Liquid-fuel family; never combined with solid-fuel evidence

families.name: ACME / BRE
families.phenomenon: Non-premixed gas flames; BRE emulates burning of condensed materials with gaseous fuels
families.treatment: Gas-phase family; BRE is not an observation of a burning solid

families.name: SPICE
families.phenomenon: Named in the PSI combustion category; scope not yet established
